_note: LAN ports per game. 'udp'/'tcp' are inbound ports allowed from strangers in public game rooms. Ranges are 'a-b'.

generals.title: C&C Generals (vanilla 1.08)
generals.tip: Options → IP Address: pick your 100.77.x.x address, then Multiplayer → Network. Everyone needs the same game version (1.08).

generals-zh.title: C&C Generals Zero Hour (1.04)
generals-zh.tip: Options → IP Address: pick your 100.77.x.x address, then Multiplayer → Network. Everyone needs the same game version (ZH 1.04). GenTool is fine if everyone has it.

generals-zh-steam.title: Zero Hour – Steam / EA App (C&C Ultimate Collection)
generals-zh-steam.tip: Options → IP Address: pick your 100.77.x.x address, then Multiplayer → Network. Everyone needs the same game version. Steam/EA and CD 1.04 builds can mismatch; keep the whole room on one source.

generals-zh-tsh.title: Zero Hour – TheSuperHackers community patch
generals-zh-tsh.tip: Options → IP Address: pick your 100.77.x.x address, then Multiplayer → Network. Everyone needs the same game version. Everyone on the same patch release.

generals-zh-rotr.title: Zero Hour mod – Rise of the Reds
generals-zh-rotr.tip: Options → IP Address: pick your 100.77.x.x address, then Multiplayer → Network. Everyone needs the same game version. Same ROTR version for all players.

generals-zh-shockwave.title: Zero Hour mod – ShockWave
generals-zh-shockwave.tip: Options → IP Address: pick your 100.77.x.x address, then Multiplayer → Network. Everyone needs the same game version. Same ShockWave version for all players.

generals-zh-contra.title: Zero Hour mod – Contra
generals-zh-contra.tip: Options → IP Address: pick your 100.77.x.x address, then Multiplayer → Network. Everyone needs the same game version. Same Contra version for all players.

generals-zh-untitled.title: Zero Hour mod – Untitled
generals-zh-untitled.tip: Options → IP Address: pick your 100.77.x.x address, then Multiplayer → Network. Everyone needs the same game version. Same mod version for all players.

generals-zh-othermod.title: Zero Hour – other mod
generals-zh-othermod.tip: Options → IP Address: pick your 100.77.x.x address, then Multiplayer → Network. Everyone needs the same game version. Put the mod name and version in the room name.

ra2.title: C&C Red Alert 2 / Yuri's Revenge
ra2.tip: Original LAN uses IPX; use CnCNet/IPX-over-UDP wrapper, then LAN.

aoe2hd.title: Age of Empires II HD / DE (LAN)

minecraft.title: Minecraft Java (Open to LAN)
minecraft.tip: Open to LAN uses a random TCP port announced via multicast 224.0.2.60:4445.

mc-bedrock.title: Minecraft Bedrock (phone / Win10 / console LAN)
mc-bedrock.tip: Friends tab → LAN Games. Works phone ↔ PC. If it doesn't appear, Add Server with the host's 100.77 IP, port 19132.

among-us.title: Among Us (Local)
among-us.tip: Local → host creates game; others open Local to find it.

mindustry.title: Mindustry
mindustry.tip: Play → Join Game, or add the host's 100.77 IP.

terraria-mobile.title: Terraria (mobile)
terraria-mobile.tip: Multiplayer → Join via IP: host's 100.77 address.

bombsquad.title: BombSquad
bombsquad.tip: Gather → Local Network, or Manual with the host's 100.77 IP.

other.title: Other game (no port filter)
other.tip: Public room without the game firewall.
